scope: Two selected-instance annotation drafts with uncertain boundaries. No new split allocation, neural improvement or hidden-cut ground truth. Current 24 body/22 partial-material inventory remains unchanged.
inputTaskFinding: Both sources show more than one heart. The current full-photo RGB-only material model has no selection input. Instance masks label the selected body as foreground and other hearts as background; the red/green source probes demonstrate that behavior. These are valid selected-instance labels, but cannot be silently treated as generic all-heart foreground supervision. A subsequent training protocol needs an explicit rough-ROI/prompt task or annotations for all hearts; this is not an established cause of the previous nineteen-photo study results.
splitFinding: Keep existing source/near-duplicate groups intact and unassigned. Cross/checker/flag and six-point-star family relationships remain unresolved; do not count them as new held-out motif families.
